questions.q: Which concept makes move behave that way? (Rust ch.1)

The worked sample prints "Borrows without taking ownership". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)

Which concept makes trait behave that way? (Rust ch.4)
The worked sample prints "Types implementing Render gain .html()". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes Result behave that way? (Rust ch.5)
